subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB748
title: Authorizes the Employment Department to require drug testing for an initial claim for unemployment benefits if the claimant was fired by the claimant's most recent employer for unlawful drug use or suitable work is available for the claimant only in an occupation that regularly conducts drug testing.
headline: SB 748 did not pass

claims.text: SB 748 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
